title: Authenticator code frequency
description: Remember personal devices after a successful authenticator code. Passwords and normal session limits still apply.
days: Ask for a code again after (days)
help: Choose 1–90 days; use 0 to require a code at every sign-in. For example, 7 days or 30 days.
effect: Changing this setting asks every remembered device to verify again at its next sign-in.
personalOnly: Only choose this on a device you control. Password resets and security changes require verification again.
invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 90.
conflict: This setting changed. Reload and try again.
forbidden: Only a group administrator can change this setting.
